title: HyperAgents public repository referenced
summary: On 2026-03-25, a dated message linked the Facebook Research GitHub repository for HyperAgents. This is a material public-reference step in the project's history because it directs readers to the project's source repository; the available evidence does not establish the repository's release contents or version.
